Mia (CSM): Quick heads up — Forklift onboarding triggered a spend alert. QBR Tuesday, need a 3-bullet cost remediation to include in the deck. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/forklift-onboard

Omar (AM): Seen it. Primary culprits: embeddings ingestion + repeated long-context queries from search. Pulling 14d token rollup now.

cost-bot: ALERT: Account=Forklift projected to breach committed credits by 28% in 7d. Breakdown: embeddings 62%, chat-gen 30%.

Sasha (FinOps): Please paste the 14d token counts when available. I'll model projected overage and dollar impact for the slide.

Leo (Solutions Eng): Rapid experiment: enable per-account KV prefix cache + cap embedding batch size to 256 + set ingest_ratelimit=600 TPS. I can validate on staging in ~2.5h.

Mia (CSM): Need customer-facing bullets I can paste into slides (what we changed now, what we recommend, owners). Keep it short.

Omar (AM): Suggested slide bullets: 1) Immediate: throttle embedding ingestion to 600 TPS (owner: Omar). 2) Short-term: enable per-account KV caching to reduce duplicate tokens (owner: Leo). 3) Policy: add budget webhook at 70% of commit + finops review (owner: Sasha). Schedule 1-hr enablement with Forklift to optimize prompts.

Sasha (FinOps): I'll attach the projected $ savings for routing to quantized variants for background jobs (~30% reduction). Need token counts from Omar to finish the calc.

Leo (Solutions Eng): Staging command I'll run: curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/v1/accounts/forklift/config -d '{"kv_cache":true,"embedding_batch_limit":256,"ingest_rate_limit":600}' and report token delta.

Mia (CSM): Great. Omar will present the cost slide at QBR. I'll add the action items and link ticket.

cost-bot: NOTE: Created ticket #CS-9427 'Forklift onboarding cost triage' (owner: Omar).
